sources.note: Own site publishes the Ruta Nacional 14 Km 739 establishment at Gobernador Virasoro, dates the family company to 1924 and describes integral yerba mate and tea production.

notes: The site also lists a CABA office; the row follows the Corrientes establishment. Coordinates are its OpenStreetMap node, 8 km from the Gobernador Virasoro centroid. Brands are not named on the pages read, so `productos estrella` is left empty.
